name: G1
compute_detail: 8-core CPU standard; EDU adds optional high-compute module (e.g. NVIDIA Orin); secondary development on EDU only
price_note: base G1 from US$13.5K (tax/shipping excl.); G1 EDU contact sales; 23 DoF base, 23-43 DoF EDU
summary: Compact, low-cost humanoid for research, education and development; arm payload ~2 kg (3 kg EDU), 9000 mAh quick-release battery.

name: H1
compute_detail: Intel Core i5 (platform) + Intel Core i7 (user development); optional Orin NX
summary: Full-size research humanoid (dims 1520+285 x 570 x 220 mm) noted for 3.3 m/s running; H1-2 variant is 70 kg with 27 DoF.

name: H2
compute_detail: PC1 Intel Core i5 (platform); EDU adds PC2 Intel Core i7 for custom development; optional module e.g. NVIDIA Thor
price_note: H2 US$29,900 (tax/shipping excl.); H2 EDU contact sales
summary: 180 cm full-size humanoid with bionic head; arm payload rated ~7 kg (peak ~15 kg).

name: Digit 5
summary: Fifth-gen logistics humanoid for tote handling, palletizing and machine tending; specs (23 kg payload, 2.2 m reach, 10:1 run-to-charge) are preliminary and the product is in development.

name: Figure 03
summary: General-purpose humanoid aimed at the home and commercial work, built around Figure's Helix VLA model; 2 kW wireless foot charging. Height 5'8" converted.

name: Optimus
summary: General-purpose bipedal humanoid; Tesla began 'early production' at Fremont in Oct 2026 with external deliveries targeted for late 2027; Tesla publishes no official spec sheet or price.

name: Atlas (electric)
summary: Enterprise industrial humanoid for material handling and part sequencing; 30 kg sustained / 50 kg instant lift, 2.3 m reach, autonomous 3-min battery swap, integrates via Orbit; early-adopter deployments.

name: Apollo 2
summary: Modular general-purpose humanoid (bipedal or wheeled base) for logistics and manufacturing, with swappable batteries; no numeric specs published on its site.

name: Walker S2
compute_detail: x86 + NVIDIA Jetson Orin; Ubuntu + ROSA 2.0
summary: Industrial humanoid that autonomously swaps its own battery in ~3 min for 24/7 work; 15 kg dual-arm payload; weight excludes hands; 42 DoF with 3rd-gen hands (30 body).

name: GR-3
compute_detail: AMD Ryzen 7 8845HS, 32 GB RAM, 1 TB; Ubuntu 22.04
summary: 'Care-bot' companion humanoid for public service and care settings; DoF is up to 55 with optional 12-DoF hands; 702+234 Wh hot-swap batteries; 6.1 km/h walk converted.

name: A2 Ultra
summary: Full-size interactive service humanoid for reception, guiding and performances, deployed at 1,000+ units; runtime 1.5 h+ walking / 3 h standing, 14.4 Ah hot-swap battery.

name: NEO
compute_detail: 1X NEO Cortex (NVIDIA Jetson Thor), up to 2070 FP4 TFLOPS
summary: Soft-bodied, tendon-driven home humanoid for chores with a voice interface and remote 'Expert Mode'; hands IP68, body IP44; imperial specs converted (5'6", 66 lb, 55 lb carry).

name: T1
compute_detail: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 32GB (200 TOPS); Standard adds Intel i7 motion-control board
summary: Small developer/RoboCup humanoid; T1 product page now redirects to a lineup of T2 and K1, so status recorded as discontinued (inferred).

name: PM01
sensors: Wide-FOV binocular camera x2 (head and waist)
summary: Lightweight, open-source research/education humanoid (2026 Education Edition specs); speed listed as >2 m/s hardware-supported; 320° waist rotation.
